notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q54887_vrouw_maria.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/sailkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. Upright on her keel at about 41 m, sunk a little into the clay and leaning slightly to starboard, bow to the south-south-west (156°): the hull whole, the paint gone, the lower fore and main masts still standing with their tops (the upper masts and the rigging gone), the stump of the trysail mast, the bowsprit broken short, no rudder (lost on the rock); a spar or two and a few cargo barrels on the clay beside her. The lean and how deep she has sunk are approximate. model_built.glb: the snow under sail in 1771. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
